narrative.overview:
The v11 precision instrument catalogue leads with existing DeepGrid visuals, physical system jobs and searchable architectures. Navy typography, cool paper and white fields, restrained copper and self-hosted Manrope modernize the homepage and the Products and Technology entry surfaces. The incumbent ink, copper, bone, Newsreader, Inter and JetBrains Mono system remains on deeper engineering routes.

The Datasheet That Argues remains the evidence discipline: show the source, the mechanism and the maturity beside each decision. A pre-silicon layout capture is labelled as a design visualization, never a die photograph. Product breadth does not imply availability or transfer DG32 evidence to another part.
keyCharacteristics: Navy and paper catalogue surfaces with dark engineering demonstrations
Manrope entry headings; retained Newsreader engineering headings, Inter prose and JetBrains Mono labels
Original DeepGrid source imagery with captions and onward inspection links
Searchable horizontal product rows retain process and individual maturity
Readable static, reduced-motion and WebGL-free explanations

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Copper is the only accent. A new state gets a new shape, weight or position, not a new hue. Teal is the single exception and it means safe, nothing else.

rules.name: The Named Colour Rule
rules.body: Repeated UI colors use named roles. V6 bone, rule and dark-surface roles are extracted from implementation; renderer material shading is documented separately. Historical color counts are not current measurements.

rules.name: The Alpha Is Not A Colour Rule
rules.body: #d4a36e1f is copper at 12%, not a separate colour. Express it from the token so a change to copper reaches every place copper is implied.

rules.name: The Verdict Heading Rule
rules.body: A heading states the finding, not the topic. A heading that ends in a question mark has not been written yet.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace means a machine produced it. Prose never sets itself in monospace for texture.

rules.name: The Joined Quantity Rule
rules.body: A number and its unit are joined by a non-breaking space, and numerals are set as tabular figures.

rules.name: The No Halo Rule
rules.body: A zero-offset coloured box-shadow is banned and gated in the build. A shadow has an offset, or it is not a shadow.

rules.name: The Resting Flatness Rule
rules.body: A surface that is part of the page carries no shadow. A shadow means the element is above the page, or is responding to a pointer.

rules.name: The No Side Tab Rule
rules.body: A thick coloured border on one edge of a panel is banned. State is carried by the whole frame, the background tint and the label.

dos: Do state a finding and print evidence type beside figures.
Do use the named palette and documented renderer material roles.
Do keep proposed integration visibly distinct from DG32 QFN-64.
Do retain individual product maturity and source links.
Do provide a complete readable reduced-motion and WebGL-free path.
Do join numbers to units and enumerate transition properties.
donts: Do not transfer DG32 evidence to other architectures.
Do not imply a representative assembly is a validated reference board.
Do not equate a safety mechanism, tapeout, award or roadmap with certification or availability.
Do not use transition: all, zero-offset colored halos or thick colored side stripes.
Do not introduce an unassigned UI near-black.
